coverage_notes.summary: OCHA OPT and WHO were explicitly checked for Gaza health-system, hospital, ambulance/transport, fuel, medical-evacuation, functioning-capacity and access disruptions; Reuters, AP, WAFA, Anadolu and UN sources were also checked. No new qualifying development was found after the prior run. Same-day casualty and aid items returned by search predated the window or duplicated already-surfaced developments.
